Out of every 3,800 persons what is the number of persons below 25 years? (correct to closest integer value)
solution:
**Given:**

Total person = 3,800

Population% below 25 years = 28 + 16.35 = 44.35%

**Solution:**

Persons below 25 years = (44.35 x 3800 ) /100 = 1685

**Hence, Out of every 3,800 persons, approximately 1,685 are the number of persons below 25 years.**
